heading: Eligible acquisition dates
lead: At the option of the owner, the acquisition of an obsolete vessel under this chapter shall occur—

tree.text: when the owner contracts for the construction or purchase of a new vessel; or
within 5 days of the actual date of delivery of the new vessel to the owner.
